# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Paladin level 2 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3-F6 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Paladin
# level-1 hybrid chassis baseline to level 2 as chosen input only. It names
# selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It
# preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat)
# and the deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield / Power Attack
# posture from the level-1 fixture, adding only the level bump this bounded
# tranche needs. Paladin grants no bonus feat at 2nd level, so no new
# choice= line is required beyond the level-1 baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell
# selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no mercy
# resolution (a 3rd-level paladin feature, still out of scope), no
# alignment-target or healing-resource accounting.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-paladin-level2
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:paladin:2
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:diplomacy:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
